cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Nothing Without Stakes
cards.instruction: Price every request and decision with a reward, penalty, bargain, or trade.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. If I apologise first, what do I win?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. And if your apology follows, do we split the victory?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then why is going first carrying all the risk?
